title: Estimating Health Hazards of Indoor Formaldehyde Exposure
author: Kangarlou, Dehdashti, et al.
materials: SKC Air Check PCXR4 sampling pump

steps.title: Apply NIOSH 3500 sampling method
steps.instruction: Use NIOSH method number 3500 for collecting indoor formaldehyde air samples.

steps.title: Assemble impingers and collect air sample
steps.instruction: Connect two glass midget impingers (each containing 20 ml of 1 % sodium bisulfate solution) in series with a trap bottle, attach the assembly to a sampling pump set at 1 L min⁻¹, and draw an 80‑L air volume covering the method’s working range of 0.02–4 ppm (0.025–4.6 mg m⁻³).

substeps.instruction: Fill each impinger with 20 ml of 1 % sodium bisulfate solution.
Serially connect the two impingers to the trap bottle.
Mount the assembly on a sampling pump.
Set pump flow rate to 1 L min⁻¹.
Collect air until 80 L has passed (covers 0.02–4 ppm range).

steps.title: Prepare sample for colorimetric analysis
steps.instruction: Take a 4‑ml aliquot from each impinger solution, place it in a 25‑ml glass‑stoppered flask, add 1 ml of 1 % chromotropic acid and 6 ml of 98 % sulfuric acid, then heat in a water bath at 95 °C for 15 min.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 4 ml of the impinger solution into a 25‑ml glass‑stoppered flask.
Add 1 ml of 1 % chromotropic acid solution.
Place the flask in a water bath set to 95 °C.

steps.title: Prepare calibration standards and measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Prepare a formaldehyde stock solution from 37 % formalin at 0.91 mg ml⁻¹, dilute it with 1 % sodium bisulfite to obtain standards ranging 0.09–1.82 µg ml⁻¹, record absorbance of each at 580 nm using a UV‑Vis spectrophotometer, and run daily calibration with the working standards.

substeps.instruction: Make stock solution: dilute 37 % formalin to achieve 0.91 mg ml⁻¹ formaldehyde.
Prepare calibration standards by diluting the stock with 1 % sodium bisulfite to concentrations of 0.09, 0.18, … up to 1.82 µg ml⁻¹.
Measure absorbance of each standard at 580 nm on a UV‑Vis spectrophotometer.
Perform daily calibration using the working standards.
